title: fix(core): compareTo on an already-past date range compares with the period before it, and previousYear from 29 February stays in February
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB727BBWue3wvnPrGZkDgyYY)_

Fixes #30197

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：指标块开启「与上一周期对比」时，「昨天」「上周」「上月」「上季度」「去年」不再拿窗口和自己比，改为对比再往前一期（前天、上上周、上上月……）；「最近 7/30/90 天」改为对比之前等长的那段日子；「与去年同期对比」在 2 月 29 日不再跑到 3 月。这些对比的文字统一为「较上期」。
- 为什么改：#30196 的验收备注发现的老问题：后向预设的对比涨跌永远是 0%，最近 N 天的对比窗口与本期重叠，闰日的去年同期错月。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `compare-to.ts` 一个文件的逻辑，不动规范、不动服务端。「今天」「本周/本月/本季度/今年」和三个前向预设的环比窗口逐字节不变；变化的只有上述后向预设，以及 2 月 29 日那天的去年同期。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① `compare-to.ts` 的 `lastPeriodBefore`（规范没有「前两期」的宏，窗口是算出来的）；② 同文件 `rollingPair` 的后向分支（N+1 天整体后移）；③ `previousYear` 的日期夹取。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/dashboard-filters.presetWindows-29116.test.ts`，预期 16 个预设全部通过，每个预设的上一期都在本期开始前一天结束。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/core` `shiftFilterByCompareTo`, `kind: 'previousPeriod'`.**
  - `{yesterday}` and `last_week_*` / `last_month_*` / `last_quarter_*` / `last_year_*` were never substituted, so the `yesterday`, `last_week`, `last_month`, `last_quarter` and `last_year` presets compared the window with itself. Now `{yesterday}` becomes `{2_days_ago}`, and each `last_*` token becomes the period before last.
  - **How "two periods back" is spelled, measured.** `DATE_MACRO_TOKENS` (`packages/spec/src/data/date-macros.zod.ts`) stops at `last_*`, and the parameterised grammar (`{N_weeks_ago}`, `{N_months_ago}`) counts from today, not from a period's first day, so no declared token names the month before last. `lastPeriodBefore` therefore computes the day: it resolves the `last_*` START through `resolveDateMacros` (the display zone, like every other token), moves it back one week / month / quarter / year with UTC calendar arithmetic, and takes the day before that `last_*` start as the end. The result is an ISO day, which `resolveDateMacros` passes through. No token is invented.
  - **Rolling windows.** `rollingPair` (was `forwardRollingPair`) now also matches `{N_days_ago}` with `{today}`. That window is N + 1 days (`last_7_days` at 2026-07-15 is 07-08..07-15, measured), and moves back by N + 1: `{(2N+1)_days_ago}` … `{(N+1)_days_ago}`. It used to become `{N_days_ago}` … `{yesterday}`, N days overlapping the current window. The forward branch now writes `{1_day_ago}` instead of `{yesterday}`, because `{yesterday}` is now itself moved; the resolved window is unchanged.
  - All substitutions still happen in ONE pass (`substituteTokens` now takes a replacer), so `today` → `yesterday` is never carried on to `2_days_ago`.
- **`kind: 'previousYear'`** built `new Date(y - 1, 1, 29)`, which is 1 March, so every window seen from 2028-02-29 was re-resolved at 2027-03-01 (`this_month` compared with March 2027). The day is clamped to the shifted month's length, 28 February.
- **`compareToTrendLabelKey`**: a `{yesterday}` or `last_*` token, and a backward rolling window, read `vsPreviousPeriod` (they read `vsYesterday`, `vsLastWeek`, `vsLastMonth`, `vsLastQuarter`, `vsLastYear`). No existing `dashboard.trend.*` key names "the month before last", and `vsPreviousPeriod` ("vs previous period", 较上期) is exact for each, so no new key, no locale or fallback change. The check runs first, since `last_month_start` also contains `month_start`.
- **Docblock correction in `NEXT_TO_CURRENT_TOKENS`** (my #30196 text): it said `next_week_*` / `next_year_*` have no `_end` in the macro vocabulary. The spec declares `next_week_end` and `next_year_end`; it is this package's resolver (`date-macros.ts`) that lacks them. The comment now says so; the mapping is unchanged.

## Why

#30197, filed from #30196's Acceptance notes. Governing text: the `compare-to.ts` docblock, "`kind: 'previousPeriod'` — the equal-length window immediately before the current one", and `previousYear` = "same week / month / quarter, one year earlier". No spec change, no new `compareTo` kind, no executor change.

## Tests

- `dashboard-filters.presetWindows-29116.test.ts`: the compareTo case pins all 16 presets at 2026-07-15 (both kinds and the label); the five `last_*` / `yesterday` rows and the three `last_N_days` rows move, the eight others keep #30196's values. New for every preset on all six reference dates: the previous window ends the day before the current window starts, with the same day count for a day, a week or a rolling window, and from the 1st for a month, quarter or year. New for every preset: `previousYear` from 2028-02-29 equals resolving the filter at 2027-02-28.
- `compare-to.test.ts`: yesterday, last week, last month (also from 2026-03-31, February then January), last quarter and last year across a year boundary, `{7_days_ago}`…`{today}` and a `$between` `{30_days_ago}`…`{today}`, a mixed `last_month_start`…`current_month_end` window moved bound by bound, the leap-day `previousYear` case, and the labels (a lone `{today}` still reads `vsYesterday`).
- `ObjectMetricWidget.compareTo.pastPresets-30197.test.tsx` (rendered, the registered `object-metric` block, the #30196 harness): `last_month` (上月), `yesterday` and `last_7_days` each show `20%` against exactly the expected previous window, under "vs previous period", and not the stale label.

## Acceptance notes

- **CONTROL, measured outside the tests.** The `tsx` probe of 16 presets × 8 reference dates × 2 kinds plus labels, `main` `ff12aed3` against this branch. Unchanged: `this_quarter`, `this_year`, `next_quarter` in full; `today`, `this_week`, `this_month`, `next_month`, `next_30_days` in every row except `previousYear` at 2028-02-29 (the leap-day fix; e.g. `this_month` 2027-03-01..03-31 → 2027-02-01..02-28). Changed as intended: `yesterday`, `last_week`, `last_month`, `last_quarter`, `last_year`, `last_7_days`, `last_30_days`, `last_90_days` (previousPeriod rows and label, plus their 2028-02-29 previousYear row where it moves).
- **Inline and executor now agree on the rolling windows.** `last_30_days` at 2026-07-15: this branch 2026-05-15..06-14; the executor (`shiftRange`, measured on #30140) 2026-05-15..06-14. On calendar presets the two still differ by design: the executor counts days, the inline path steps whole periods.
- Out of scope, unchanged: the client resolver lacks `next_week_end` / `next_year_end`, which the spec declares (see the docblock correction above).

## Verification

<details><summary>Suites, type-check, lint, ablations</summary>

- Under `os-verify-lock`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 packages/core/` exit 0 (232 files, 4,321 passed, 27 skipped); `packages/plugin-dashboard/` exit 0 (202 files, 1,928 passed, 6 skipped).
- `pnpm run type-check` in core and plugin-dashboard: exit 0.
- `npx eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors (warnings only, `no-explicit-any`, as in the surrounding code).
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each red then restored to HEAD):
  - past tokens (`lastPeriodBefore` not called): 12 failed, covering the five past-token pins, the five 29116 rows, and the rendered `last_month` and `yesterday` rows;
  - backward rolling (`ROLLING_DAYS_RE` limited to `from_now`): 6 failed (the rolling pin, the label pin, the three `last_N_days` rows, the rendered `last_7_days` row);
  - leap day (clamp removed): 12 failed (the leap pin and the 11 presets whose 2028-02-29 `previousYear` window moves);
  - label (past-token check removed): 6 failed.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 35): see the report on #30197.

</details>
